Choose a section with the remote. Back always returns here first.
ADVANCED has local ADB setup and power tools. Android debugging approval is required once.

SHIELD TURBO starts silently after reboot. If automatic CLEAN START or persistent TURBO is enabled, the Shield may briefly seem to hang while its saved startup work finishes. That small pause can be normal. No CLEAN START banner or startup pop-up is shown.

TURBO persists across reboot and uses only NVIDIA stock performance controls. A thermal watchdog stays active while TURBO is on. If Android reports SEVERE thermal status or higher, SHIELD TURBO automatically restores NORMAL and leaves TURBO off until you turn it on again. No root, voltage changes, above-stock clocks or thermal-limit bypass are used.
Set SHIELD Processor mode to Optimized first, then capture the baseline. This reads settings and properties only. Nothing is changed.
Optimized baseline is saved. Set SHIELD Processor mode to Max performance, return here, then capture MAX.

The processor trace could not be captured. No settings were changed.

Set SHIELD Processor mode to Optimized first. This one-shot test briefly requests Max performance, verifies NVIDIA’s downstream CPU/GPU/FRT state, then restores Optimized. It writes only nv_power_mode and does not leave TURBO enabled.

This is one snapshot, not a benchmark. A missing or restricted reading does not mean the device is faulty. The exposed thermal zone is not automatically the CPU or GPU temperature.
Diagnostics do not change files, apps or tuning settings. Picture brightness remains a separate user control.

STANDARD Measurements stay on this device.
ADB TURBO Press ENABLE ADB TURBO in ADVANCED. Enable Network Debugging in Android once and approve the debugging prompt. The app connects only to this Shield, verifies shell access, and grants its own animation-setting permission. No computer command is needed. Each power operation closes its connection.
ROOT The app never invokes su or changes the bootloader.
Picture brightness keeps its separate display-over-other-apps permission.
